<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 500" width="600" height="500">
  <!-- White background rect -->
  <rect width="600" height="500" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Styles -->
  <style>
    text {
      font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      fill: #000000;
    }
    .math {
      font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .bold {
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    line, path, rect, circle, polyline {
      fill: none;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 2;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }
    .solution {
      fill: #e6f2ff;
      stroke: none;
    }
    .glass {
      fill: none;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 2;
    }
    .electrode {
      fill: #333333;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 1.5;
    }
    .bubble {
      fill: #ffffff;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 1;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- --- BEAKER --- -->
  <!-- Beaker body (open top, flat bottom, slightly flared rim) -->
  <!-- Center of beaker is around x = 300 -->
  <!-- Let beaker go from x = 180 to x = 420, height from y = 180 to y = 380 -->
  
  <!-- Solution inside beaker -->
  <rect x="181" y="210" width="238" height="169" class="solution" />
  
  <!-- Liquid level line -->
  <line x1="181" y1="210" x2="419" y2="210" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <!-- Wave pattern for liquid level to be clear? A simple straight line with a note or just straight line is standard for O-level physics/chemistry -->

  <!-- Beaker outline -->
  <path d="M 170 170 
           L 180 170 
           L 180 380 
           C 180 390, 190 390, 200 390
           L 400 390
           C 410 390, 420 390, 420 380
           L 420 170
           L 430 170" 
        class="glass" />
  <!-- Beaker lip highlights -->
  <path d="M 170 170 C 170 167, 175 167, 180 167" class="glass" />
  <path d="M 420 170 C 420 167, 425 167, 430 167" class="glass" />

  <!-- --- ELECTRODES (coming up through the bottom) --- -->
  <!-- Left electrode (Anode, connected to +) at x = 240 -->
  <rect x="232" y="320" width="16" height="85" class="electrode" />
  <!-- Right electrode (Cathode, connected to -) at x = 360 -->
  <rect x="352" y="320" width="16" height="85" class="electrode" />

  <!-- Openings in bottom of beaker for electrodes to pass through (sealed) -->
  <rect x="230" y="388" width="20" height="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <rect x="350" y="388" width="20" height="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />


  <!-- --- TEST TUBES (inverted over electrodes) --- -->
  <!-- Left Test Tube (Anode / Gas X): liquid level higher inside (less gas) -> liquid at y = 250 -->
  <g id="left-tube">
    <!-- Tube gas space (white) -->
    <rect x="215" y="140" width="50" height="110" fill="#ffffff" />
    <!-- Tube liquid space (solution inside tube) -->
    <rect x="215" y="250" width="50" height="60" class="solution" />
    <!-- Liquid level inside left tube -->
    <line x1="215" y1="250" x2="265" y2="250" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <!-- Tube walls and rounded top -->
    <path d="M 215 160 
             L 215 310 
             L 265 310 
             L 265 160
             C 265 145, 215 145, 215 160 Z" class="glass" />
  </g>

  <!-- Right Test Tube (Cathode / Gas Y): liquid level lower inside (twice as much gas) -> liquid at y = 290 -->
  <g id="right-tube">
    <!-- Tube gas space (white) -->
    <rect x="335" y="100" width="50" height="190" fill="#ffffff" />
    <!-- Tube liquid space (solution inside tube) -->
    <rect x="335" y="290" width="50" height="20" class="solution" />
    <!-- Liquid level inside right tube -->
    <line x1="335" y1="290" x2="385" y2="290" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <!-- Tube walls and rounded top -->
    <path d="M 335 120 
             L 335 310 
             L 385 310 
             L 385 120
             C 385 105, 335 105, 335 120 Z" class="glass" />
  </g>


  <!-- --- BUBBLES --- -->
  <!-- Bubbles rising from left electrode -->
  <circle cx="240" cy="310" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="238" cy="295" r="2.5" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="242" cy="280" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="239" cy="265" r="2" class="bubble" />

  <!-- Bubbles rising from right electrode -->
  <circle cx="360" cy="310" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="362" cy="298" r="3.5" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="358" cy="282" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="361" cy="265" r="2.5" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="359" cy="250" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="362" cy="235" r="2" class="bubble" />


  <!-- --- WIRING AND BATTERY --- -->
  <!-- Wires from electrodes going down and to a battery at the bottom -->
  <polyline points="240,405 240,430 180,430 180,455" />
  <polyline points="360,405 360,430 420,430 420,455" />

  <!-- DC Battery symbol (long thin, short thick bars) -->
  <!-- Centered around x = 300, y = 455 -->
  <!-- Left side (Positive terminal, connects to left electrode / anode) -->
  <line x1="280" y1="445" x2="280" y2="465" stroke-width="3" /> <!-- Long plate (+) -->
  <line x1="292" y1="450" x2="292" y2="460" stroke-width="6" /> <!-- Short plate (-) -->

  <!-- Right side (Negative terminal, connects to right electrode / cathode) -->
  <line x1="308" y1="450" x2="308" y2="460" stroke-width="6" /> <!-- Short plate (+) -->
  <line x1="320" y1="445" x2="320" y2="465" stroke-width="3" /> <!-- Long plate (-) -->
  
  <!-- Wait, standard battery symbol: alternating long and short lines -->
  <!-- Let's draw a standard 2-cell or simple DC power supply box, or standard cell lines: -->
  <!-- Let's clear the battery and draw a clear standard DC cell / battery representation: -->
  <g transform="translate(260, 440)">
    <!-- Cell 1 -->
    <line x1="10" y1="5" x2="10" y2="25" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="20" y1="10" x2="20" y2="20" stroke-width="6" />
    <!-- Cell 2 -->
    <line x1="30" y1="5" x2="30" y2="25" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="40" y1="10" x2="40" y2="20" stroke-width="6" />
    <!-- Connecting lines inside battery group -->
    <line x1="0" y1="15" x2="10" y2="15" />
    <line x1="40" y1="15" x2="50" y2="15" />
    
    <!-- Terminals + and - -->
    <text x="2" y="5" class="bold" font-size="16">+</text>
    <text x="43" y="5" class="bold" font-size="16">−</text>
  </g>


  <!-- --- LABELS & POINTER LINES --- -->

  <!-- Dilute sodium chloride solution label -->
  <text x="435" y="215">dilute sodium chloride solution</text>
  <polyline points="435,210 415,210" />

  <!-- Gas X label -->
  <text x="75" y="180">gas X</text>
  <path d="M 115 175 L 210 175" />

  <!-- Gas Y label -->
  <text x="435" y="145">gas Y</text>
  <path d="M 435 145 L 380 145" />

  <!-- Anode label -->
  <text x="75" y="340">anode</text>
  <path d="M 115 335 L 230 335" />

  <!-- Cathode label -->
  <text x="435" y="340">cathode</text>
  <path d="M 435 335 L 370 335" />


  <!-- --- CAPTION --- -->
  <text x="275" y="490" class="bold">Fig. 3.1</text>

</svg>

  <!-- --- LABELS & POINTER LINES --- -->

  <path d="M 455,165 L 400,165" />

  <path d="M 125,355 L 250,355" />

  <text x="300" y="515" class="bold">Fig. 3.1</text>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 680 550" width="680" height="550">
  <!-- White background rect -->
  <rect width="680" height="550" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Styles -->
  <style>
    text {
      font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      fill: #000000;
    }
    .bold {
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    line, path, rect, circle, polyline {
      fill: none;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 2;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }
    .solution {
      fill: #e6f2ff;
      stroke: none;
    }
    .glass {
      fill: none;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 2;
    }
    .electrode {
      fill: #333333;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 1.5;
    }
    .bubble {
      fill: #ffffff;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 1;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- --- BEAKER --- -->
  <!-- Beaker body centered further away from edges -->
  <!-- Beaker from x = 210 to x = 450, height from y = 190 to y = 400 -->
  
  <!-- Solution inside beaker -->
  <rect x="211" y="230" width="238" height="169" class="solution" />
  
  <!-- Liquid level line -->
  <line x1="211" y1="230" x2="449" y2="230" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Beaker outline -->
  <path d="M 200 190 
           L 210 190 
           L 210 400 
           C 210 410, 220 410, 230 410
           L 430 410
           C 440 410, 450 410, 450 400
           L 450 190
           L 460 190" 
        class="glass" />
  <!-- Beaker lip highlights -->
  <path d="M 200 190 C 200 187, 205 187, 210 187" class="glass" />
  <path d="M 450 190 C 450 187, 455 187, 460 187" class="glass" />

  <!-- --- ELECTRODES (coming up through the bottom) --- -->
  <!-- Left electrode (Anode, connected to +) at x = 270 -->
  <rect x="262" y="340" width="16" height="85" class="electrode" />
  <!-- Right electrode (Cathode, connected to -) at x = 390 -->
  <rect x="382" y="340" width="16" height="85" class="electrode" />

  <!-- Openings in bottom of beaker for electrodes to pass through (sealed) -->
  <rect x="260" y="408" width="20" height="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <rect x="380" y="408" width="20" height="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />


  <!-- --- TEST TUBES (inverted over electrodes) --- -->
  <!-- Left Test Tube (Anode / Gas X): liquid level higher inside (less gas) -> liquid at y = 270 -->
  <g id="left-tube">
    <!-- Tube gas space (white) -->
    <rect x="245" y="160" width="50" height="110" fill="#ffffff" />
    <!-- Tube liquid space (solution inside tube) -->
    <rect x="245" y="270" width="50" height="60" class="solution" />
    <!-- Liquid level inside left tube -->
    <line x1="245" y1="270" x2="295" y2="270" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <!-- Tube walls and rounded top -->
    <path d="M 245 180 
             L 245 330 
             L 295 330 
             L 295 180
             C 295 165, 245 165, 245 180 Z" class="glass" />
  </g>

  <!-- Right Test Tube (Cathode / Gas Y): liquid level lower inside (twice as much gas) -> liquid at y = 310 -->
  <g id="right-tube">
    <!-- Tube gas space (white) -->
    <rect x="365" y="120" width="50" height="190" fill="#ffffff" />
    <!-- Tube liquid space (solution inside tube) -->
    <rect x="365" y="310" width="50" height="20" class="solution" />
    <!-- Liquid level inside right tube -->
    <line x1="365" y1="310" x2="415" y2="310" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
    <!-- Tube walls and rounded top -->
    <path d="M 365 140 
             L 365 330 
             L 415 330 
             L 415 140
             C 415 125, 365 125, 365 140 Z" class="glass" />
  </g>


  <!-- --- BUBBLES --- -->
  <!-- Bubbles rising from left electrode -->
  <circle cx="270" cy="330" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="268" cy="315" r="2.5" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="272" cy="300" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="269" cy="285" r="2" class="bubble" />

  <!-- Bubbles rising from right electrode -->
  <circle cx="390" cy="330" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="392" cy="318" r="3.5" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="388" cy="302" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="391" cy="285" r="2.5" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="389" cy="270" r="3" class="bubble" />
  <circle cx="392" cy="255" r="2" class="bubble" />


  <!-- --- WIRING AND BATTERY --- -->
  <!-- Wires from electrodes going down and to a battery at the bottom -->
  <polyline points="270,425 270,450 210,450 210,475" />
  <polyline points="390,425 390,450 450,450 450,475" />

  <!-- DC Battery symbol (centered around x = 330, y = 475) -->
  <g transform="translate(305, 460)">
    <!-- Cell 1 -->
    <line x1="10" y1="5" x2="10" y2="25" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="20" y1="10" x2="20" y2="20" stroke-width="6" />
    <!-- Cell 2 -->
    <line x1="30" y1="5" x2="30" y2="25" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="40" y1="10" x2="40" y2="20" stroke-width="6" />
    <!-- Connecting lines inside battery group -->
    <line x1="0" y1="15" x2="10" y2="15" />
    <line x1="40" y1="15" x2="50" y2="15" />
    
    <!-- Terminals + and - -->
    <text x="2" y="3" class="bold" font-size="16">+</text>
    <text x="43" y="3" class="bold" font-size="16">−</text>
  </g>


  <!-- --- LABELS & POINTER LINES --- -->

  <!-- Dilute sodium chloride solution label (placed comfortably inside the 680 width) -->
  <text x="470" y="235">dilute sodium chloride solution</text>
  <polyline points="470,230 450,230" />

  <!-- Gas X label -->
  <text x="80" y="195">gas X</text>
  <path d="M 120,190 L 245,190" />

  <!-- Gas Y label -->
  <text x="470" y="165">gas Y</text>
  <path d="M 470,165 L 415,165" />

  <!-- Anode label -->
  <text x="80" y="360">anode</text>
  <path d="M 120,355 L 262,355" />

  <!-- Cathode label -->
  <text x="470" y="360">cathode</text>
  <path d="M 470,355 L 398,355" />


  <!-- --- CAPTION --- -->
  <text x="315" y="525" class="bold">Fig. 3.1</text>

</svg>
